target: candidate653 all-block converse and stated minimax consequences
scope: Known fixed0<k<1; unknown familyk in[k0,1] with fixed0<k0<1. No extension to known identity or unrestricted k->1 paths.

critical_checks.causal_reference: R_j=X plus past N outputs is correct. Current TP branches have the same R_j marginal; F_j is independent of R_j despite input entanglement.
critical_checks.sum_K: Conditional-entropy DPI after degrading all-signal past gives sumK>=S(Phi^m|X)>=m g(t). No individual K>=g(t) is assumed.
critical_checks.flat_Choi: Exact c=1/[(1-k)(n+1)] from1004.0196v3; Schmidt approximation/purification extends it to mixed quantum references, giving individual d_j=log2c+K_j>=0.
critical_checks.cost: Only total mean energy is used; entropy concavity is applied after summing. Marginals may individually exceed E.
critical_checks.average_controls: Near-capacity gives bounded average d_j and average divergence to common gamma_M; vacuum mass vanishes on average.
critical_checks.index_selection: Two Markov bounds control the bad fraction, with no m union factor.
critical_checks.quantum_reference_window: Original rho_R retained; posterior relative entropy and +log v signs correct. Conditional blocks have finite entropy for each finite code.
critical_checks.infinite_TRE: Normalized compression preserves order and yields exact separable-reference TRE by lower semicontinuity; no dimension/block-length error.
critical_checks.Helstrom: Actual binary error<=eps_E+r_E; factor2 not needed. Test estimates H(F_j|R_jB_j), not a message-informed decoder.
critical_checks.capacity: Uniform m bound enters Holevo-Fano at fixed E,n,a before E-limit; no reset-channel additivity or Gaussian optimizer assumed.
critical_checks.unknown_family: Converse chooses only worst pairk0,N; common lower bound serves all members including identity.

result.sufficiency: Complete unassisted Shannon and fixed-finite-alpha>1 loss curves for n=o(E), including bounded/zero bath, and for unknown envelopeN=o(E), without EB/divergence premises.
result.necessity: Imported627/644 common strict bound excludes complete saturation along any non-sublinear subsequence.
result.budgets: All finite B>=0 uniformly; a-matching and clipping included.
result.operational: Arbitrary entangled block encoding under total expected photon cost, vanishing average-message error, fixed memoryless channel/reset, no preshared entanglement.

uniform_remainder: q h(1/(M+1))+eta_E, eta_E=h(eps_E+r_E)+h(lambda)[sqrt(A_E)+C_d/sqrt(log2 S)], independent of m,a, label count, entanglement and energy allocation.

dependencies.role: Inherited Choi/window/domain framework, with new mixed-reference and TRE extension checks written explicitly in654. No whole-manuscript re-audit.
Strict common-code necessity and finite E,N operational closures.
Common physical unassisted cq lower bound for any sublinear envelope, including bounded or zero bath; all reset orientations/energies.
Budget witness matching only; no inference of new block converse from EB result.

results.scope: finite causal-reference/conditional-entropy identities and DPI diagnostics only; not infinite-dimensional minimum output, TRE asymptotics, operational capacity or novelty proof

analytical_certificates.flat_choi_substitution: Holevo one-mode norm 1/(m_noise+|k_amp^2-1|/2), with m_noise=delta(n+1/2), k_amp^2=k, equals1/[delta(n+1)].
analytical_certificates.causal_reference: R_j=X B_<j after N. Local branch TP maps leave its marginal unchanged, so F_j is independent of R_j.
analytical_certificates.TRE_extension: Normalized finite-rank-plus-flag compression preserves r<=Ls. Apply dimension-free finite TRE and pass using trace-norm convergence and lower semicontinuity. Constant does not acquire reference dimension or entropy.
analytical_certificates.Helstrom_error: With e_g+e_s<=r_E, actual error lambda(1-p)+lambda p e_g+q a v e_s<=epsilon_E+r_E; no factor2 needed.
analytical_certificates.total_cost: Only sum_j mu_j<=mM is used. Jensen is applied after summation; no individual e_j<=E is assumed.

own_exact.scope: Symbolic bookkeeping and pointers to the explicit proofs in report.txt; not a substitute for the block/domain argument.
